Subject: Re: QBR prep: UKBRacing - infra check (metrics)

On it — initial findings below. Will follow up with a short table for the deck.

Preliminary QA:
- 95th percentile latency for sequences >1024 tokens: +38% (baseline week-over-week).
- 99th percentile: +72% (spikes correlate with batch sizes hitting autoscale boundaries).
- Model variant change: there was a rollout of v2-quantized on Apr 4 targeted to reduce cost; we saw higher variance on long sequences.

Mitigation plan (short):
1) Pin routing for UKRacing traffic to the stable runtime (v1-optimized) for the next 72 hours.
2) Adjust autoscale thresholds to reduce batch-size-induced queuing on race-day spikes.
3) Longer-term: schedule a quantization rollback / retune and run a 48-hr soak test.

I'll assemble the numbers and a small chart for the tail-latency slide by EOD tomorrow.

Evelyn Hart
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
evelyn@redwood.com
